problem: Short or over, clear every morning
action: Morning on the forecourt, at the same open tank hatch as before. The dealer is standing straight this time, not crouched, holding the dip rod loosely upright in one hand and his phone in the other, glancing between them. He is upright, easy, and finished — the posture of a man whose sum has already come out.
lighting: The same low raking morning sun as the earlier dip shot, but warmer and cleaner, less haze, the shadows friendlier.
camera: Waist-up, he is centre-right of the vertical frame with the rod running up the left side. Sharp on him. 35mm. Deliberately the mirror of the earlier crouched dip shot.
detail: The rod carries plain machined graduations, NO numbers or printed markings. The phone screen is DARK. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: The same job as before, done in ten seconds instead of hanging over him all month.
motion: He lowers the dip rod slightly and glances down at the phone, then straightens. A slow push in. No cuts, no camera shake, nobody enters frame, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: तेल कम है या ज़्यादा, हर सुबह साफ़-साफ़। महीने बाद नहीं।
